description:
List conversation messages

Returns a page of the transcript of a chat conversation, oldest message first, so paging forward follows the conversation in order. This endpoint serves chat threads only: an id that belongs to a voice call is rejected with 400 rather than a misleading 404, and the transcript of a call is carried on the call record itself. Unlike the conversation list, the pagination object here carries a real `total`, counted over the whole transcript.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.

name: list_conversation_messages
